title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE CHILD CARE SUPPORT ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purposes) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters mandated by the Child Care Support Act and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Qualifications of child care providers) "Specific qualifications prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 7(1)2 of the Child Care Support Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means any of the following qualifications: <Amended on Apr. 21, 2026>
  1. Qualification as a grade I child care teacher under Article 21(3) of the Child Care Act;
  2. Qualification as a grade I regular kindergarten teacher under Article 22(2) of the Early Childhood Education Act;
  3. Qualification as a grade I regular teacher of an elementary school or special school (limited to kindergarten or elementary school courses) under Article 21(2) of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act;
  4. Deleted. <Apr. 21, 2026>
  [Title Amended on Apr. 21, 2026]

Article 2-2 (Designation of an agency exclusively responsible for the management of qualifications of child care providers) "Public institution prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 7(5) and Article 10-3(3) of the Act means the Korean Institute for Healthy Family established under Article 34-2 of the Framework Act on Healthy Families (hereinafter referred to as the "Korean Institute for Healthy Family").
  [This Article Added on Apr. 21, 2026]

Article 3 (Scope of financial information) The scope of financial information, credit information, and insurance information (hereinafter referred to as "financial information, etc.") that a guardian and his or her family members shall consent to provide when applying for subsidization of expenses for child care services pursuant to Article 22(2) of the Act shall be as follows:
  1. Financial information prescribed in Article 22(2)1 of the Act:
  a. Demand deposits such as ordinary deposits, savings deposits, free savings deposits, and foreign currency deposits: Average balance within the last three months;
  b. Time and savings deposits, such as time deposits, installment savings deposits, and installment savings: Deposit balance or total amount of deposits;
  c. Stocks, beneficiary certificates, investments, investment shares, and real estate trusts, pension trusts: The final market price; and in such cases, Article 54(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Inheritance Tax and Gift Tax Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to assessing the value of unlisted stocks;
  d. Bonds, promissory notes, checks, debt certificates, certificates of preemptive right to new stocks, or transferable deposit certificates: Face value;
  e. Annuity savings: Amount paid periodically or the final balance;
  2. Credit information prescribed in Article 22(2)2 of the Act:
  a. Status of loans and details of payment in arrears;
  b. Unpaid credit card amount;
  3. Insurance information prescribed in Article 22(2)3 of the Act:
  a. Insurance policies: Amount to be refunded if an insurance contract is canceled, or insurance money paid within the last year;
  b. Annuity insurance: Amount to be refunded if an insurance contract is canceled, or amount of money paid periodically.

Article 4 (Request for and provision of financial information) (1) The documents referred to in Article 23(1) of the Act shall include the following:
  1. Names and resident registration numbers;
  2. The scope of financial information, etc. referred to in Article 23(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "financial information, etc.") requested, and the base date and period for inquiry into such information.
  (2) If the head of a financial institution, etc. requested to provide financial information, etc. pursuant to Article 23(2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "financial institution, etc.") provides the relevant financial information, etc. to the Minister of Gender Equality and Family or the head of a local government, he or she shall include the following: <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>
  1. Names and resident registration numbers of persons whose financial information, etc. is provided;
  2. Names of financial institutions, etc. providing financial information, etc.;
  3. Names and account numbers of financial products to be provided;
  4. Details of financial information, etc.
  (3) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family or the head of a local government may request the head of a financial institution, etc. to provide financial information, etc. referred to in paragraph (1) through the information and communications networks of associations or federations of which the relevant financial institution, etc. are a member. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 5 (Delegation and entrustment of authority) (1) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall delegate the following authority, under Article 34(1) of the Act, to the Special Metropolitan City Mayor, a Metropolitan City Mayor, a Special Self-Governing City Mayor, a Do Governor, a Special Self-Governing Province Governor (hereinafter referred to as a "Mayor/Do Governor"), or the head of a Si/Gun/Gu (referring to the head of an autonomous Gu; hereinafter the same shall apply), who has designated child care service agencies under Article 11(1) of the Act: <Added on Apr. 21, 2026>
  1. Authority relating to requests for criminal background checks under the main clause of Article 6-2(2) of the Act with respect to persons seeking to work as child care providers at child care service agencies designated under Article 11(1) of the Act;
  2. Authority relating to requests for criminal background checks under the main clause of Article 11-5(2) of the Act with respect to persons seeking to engage in the affairs of child care service agencies designated under Article 11(1) of the Act.
  (2) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall delegate the following authority, under Article 34(1) of the Act, to the Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, or the head of a Si/Gun/Gu who has registered a child care service agency under Article 11-2(1) of the Act: <Added on Apr. 21, 2026>
  1. Authority relating to requests for criminal background checks under the main clause of Article 6-2(2) of the Act with respect to persons seeking to work as child care providers or child care helpers at child care service agencies registered under Article 11-2(1) of the Act;
  2. Authority relating to requests for criminal background checks under the main clause of Article 11-5(2) of the Act with respect to persons seeking to engage in the affairs of child care service agencies registered under Article 11-2(1) of the Act.
  (3) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall delegate to the Mayor/Do Governor, under Article 34(1) of the Act, the authority under the main clause of Article 11-5(2) of the Act relating to requests for criminal background checks on persons seeking to engage in the affairs of metropolitan child care support centers designated under Article 10-4(1) of the Act. <Added on Apr. 21, 2026>
  (4) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall delegate to the Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, or the head of a Si/Gun/Gu, under Article 34(2) of the Act, the authority relating to the suspension and revocation of qualifications of child care providers under Articles 32 and 33 of the Act. <Amended on Apr. 21, 2026>
  (5) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall entrust the following affairs to the Korean Institute for Healthy Family under Article 34(3) of the Act: <Added on Apr. 21, 2026>
  1. Affairs relating to requests for criminal background checks on persons seeking to become child care providers under Article 6-2(1) of the Act;
  2. The following affairs relating to the management of qualifications of child care providers under Article 7 of the Act:
  a. Development of aptitude and personality test tools and administration of such tests;
  b. Qualification examination for child care providers;
  c. Issuance of certificates of qualifications for child care providers;
  3. Management of and support for continuing education conducted under Article 10(1) of the Act.
  (6) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall entrust continuing education for child care providers under Article 10(1) of the Act to an educational institution designated under Article 9(1) of the Act or a child care service agency in accordance with Article 34(3) of the Act. In such cases, the Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall publicly notify the institution entrusted with such affairs and the details of the affairs entrusted thereto. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025; Apr. 21, 2026>
  (7) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall entrust the following affairs to the Korea Social Security Information Service under Article 29(1) of the Act on the Use and Provision of Social Security Benefits and Search for Eligible Beneficiaries, in accordance with Article 34(3) of the Act: <Amended on Dec. 31, 2021; Oct. 1, 2025; Apr. 21, 2026>
  1. Affairs relating to requests for provision of financial information, etc. under Article 23(1) of the Act;
  2. Affairs relating to requests for provision of data under Article 24(2) of the Act.

Article 6 (Processing of sensitive information and personally identifiable information) (1) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family and the head of a local government (including a person to whom the authority of the Minister of Gender Equality and Family or the head of a local government has been delegated or entrusted) may, if unavoidable for performing the following affairs, process information relating to health under Article 23 of the Personal Information Protection Act, information constituting criminal history records under subparagraph 2 of Article 18 of the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and data containing a resident registration number, passport number, or alien registration number under subparagraph 1, 2, or 4 of Article 19 of that Decree: <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025; Apr. 21, 2026>
  1. Verification of grounds for disqualification of child care providers, child care helpers, employees, etc. under Articles 6 and 11-5 of the Act;
  1-2. Granting qualifications as child care providers under Article 7 of the Act;
  2. Continuing education for child care providers under Article 10 of the Act;
  3. Establishment and operation of child care sharing centers under Article 19 of the Act;
  4. Issuance of certificates for verification of identity of child care helpers under Article 19-2 of the Act;
  5. Subsidization, in whole or in part, of expenses incurred in providing child care services under Article 20 of the Act;
  6. Provision of child care vouchers under Article 21 of the Act;
  7. Application for subsidization of expenses for child care services, request for the provision of financial information, etc., and verification of eligibility for subsidization under Articles 22 through 24 of the Act;
  8. Construction and operation of electronic systems under Article 25 of the Act;
  9. Suspension and revocation of qualifications of child care providers under Articles 32 and 33 of the Act.
  (2) The heads of the following institutions may process data containing resident registration numbers, passport numbers, or alien registration numbers under subparagraph 1, 2, or 4 of Article 19 of the Enforcement Decree of the Personal Information Protection Act, if unavoidable to perform the affairs prescribed in the relevant subparagraphs: <Amended on Apr. 21, 2026>
  1. An educational institution designated under Article 9(1) of the Act: Education courses for child care providers under that Article;
  2. The central child care support center designated under Article 10-3(1) of the Act: Operation of the information system under paragraph (2)5 of that Article;
  3. Deleted; <Apr. 21, 2026>
  4. A child care service agency designated under Article 11(1) of the Act: Provision of child care services under that Article;
  5. A child care service agency registered under Article 11-2(1) of the Act: Provision of child care services under that Article.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Dec. 31, 2021]

Article 6-2 Deleted. <Mar. 24, 2026>

Article 7 (Standards for imposition of administrative fines) The standards for imposing administrative fines under Article 37(2) of the Act shall be as specified in the Appendix.
